statements.proposition: The change keeps full backward compatibility for existing pip-only environments
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Impact claim with no single concrete check settling it. Observations pull both ways: the pip path is kept as a fallback, but detection now prefers uv whenever uv is on PATH (even in a pip-using setup), the pip-only flow no longer runs 'pip install -U pip', and venvtools.py removed the public helpers create() and create_venv_with_package(); code search of the package at base found these names only in the setup scripts changed here, so no external user was found. Whether the behaviour counts as compatible depends on interpretation.
evidence: file list: package_manager.py added; install.py, prepare.py, venvtools.py, build_pygen_wheel.py modified; no test files
install.py patch: pip-only flow now routes through create_venv_with_package_manager/install_packages, uv preferred if present
venvtools.py patch: deletes create() and create_venv_with_package()
gh code search for create_venv_with_package under packages/http-client-python: hits only in setup scripts
